headline: Why are drug purchase interruptions occurring in Uzbekistan, and how does SSV plan to solve this problem
summary: Uzbekistan plans to introduce multi-year state contracts of up to three years for drug purchases from January 2027. Health Minister Eldor Adilov said the current one-year system is causing supply gaps.
why: State procurement rules shape demand and pricing for pharmaceutical suppliers. Longer contracts can give suppliers more revenue visibility.
original_headline: O‘zbekistonda dori vositalari xaridida nega uzilishlar yuzaga kelmoqda va SSV bu muammoni qanday hal qilmoqchi
